checks.description: Full-install rollback with heartbeat and data preservation
checks.evidence: Existing R185 full-install snapshot/restore and heartbeat acknowledgement. R213 tests real PowerShell backup/restore functions with synthetic EXE, plugin, config, quarantined new install, SHA-256 tampering rejection, and data-root protection (CI pending). Physical failed-update/second-PC acceptance remains required. R219 corrects the updater's R191 'invalid verified update staging scope': published SHA256 lines contain the filename, which the former Stage() rejected after Verify() succeeded. Both now share a strict canonical SHA parser, with end-to-end synthetic Windows coverage pending. Existing installations cannot self-repair without running a build containing this fix. R220 adds a production packaging bridge that publishes the already-verified installer SHA256 as precisely 64 ASCII digits without newline; existing R191 clients accept bare hashes and no old app-side modification is required when the next properly packaged release is available. Synthetic Windows tests pending. R222: updater streams downloads to same-directory uniquely named partial files, replaces the cached setup only after complete byte count and cleans stale partials; native Windows tests pending. Checksum, PE, peer and rollback protections preserved. R224 dev-only: post-install primary widget must remain Loaded for 12s before writing matching ready receipt, avoiding false success from immediate post-start crash. Windows CI pending; real installed-PC rollback still pending. R227: demonstrated mutex/relaunch storm in user logs; supervisor contention now exits cleanly without fallback spawn, cross-process release replay hints bounded, handoff preflights installed supervisor mutex; native Windows regression pending. R229 dev: updater now downloads/validates before deferral when another DeskSpace window owns unsaved work, reuses cached installer only after current official SHA256 and GitHub release metadata checks, and waits for safe normal peer exit before supervised install. Physical-PC test pending. R230: user-requested automatic graceful closure of all Workspace, floating monitor widget and tray processes before installation; per-install scoped WPF close IPC, older-version WM_CLOSE fallback, process-zero gate, unsaved-work cancellations honoured, no forced close and no Inno /CLOSEAPPLICATIONS. Real physical-PC verification pending. R233 development: a single held supervisor exit event now triggers one normal WPF close attempt rather than recurring unsaved-work prompts every eight seconds; regression and Windows CI pending. Full installed-device acceptance still required.
